Sync your words

One list on every browser and on the web.

Free and optional. Your words, saved sentences and settings stay the same in every browser you sign in to, and on the Dashboard on any device.

Without an account, everything stays in this browser.

Voice

A more natural Taiwan voice (Microsoft Azure). Its free tier covers far more than you’ll use.

Create a Speech resource (free F0 tier), open Keys and Endpoint, and paste Key 1 here. Check finds the region.

Without a key, the card uses Google’s voice.
